# The substrate VM's whole compose stack: every surface behind the one shared Caddy container,
# routed by hostname. Today that's the cycsail.team portal (gated by oauth2-proxy) and the people
# hub (Directus, its own native Google OIDC login — no oauth2-proxy needed for that surface). Secret
# values come from an env file written at boot from Secret Manager (see cloud-init in
# infrastructure/src/portal-bootstrap.ts) — nothing sensitive lives in git.
services:
  caddy:
    image: ${PORTAL_IMAGE}
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      SITE_DOMAIN: ${SITE_DOMAIN}
      CRM_DOMAIN: ${CRM_DOMAIN}
    ports:
      - "80:80"
      - "443:443"
    volumes:
      - caddy_data:/data
      - caddy_config:/config
    depends_on:
      - oauth2-proxy
      - directus

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Deploy Directus on the substrate VM alongside the portal

Generalizes the substrate compose stack from portal-only to shared: Caddy
now routes by hostname (cycsail.team to the static portal via oauth2-proxy,
crm.<internalDomain> straight to Directus, which handles its own native
Google OIDC login - no oauth2-proxy needed for that surface). Directus
talks to its own database on the shared Cloud SQL instance over private IP
directly (same VPC, no proxy needed).

Adds the crm.<internalDomain> DNS A record (same pattern as portal.ts's own
record) and threads the new Directus secrets + DB host through
portal-bootstrap.ts's cloud-init.
EOF
)"
